text:
alice-sales: Hey team — FrostoPay POC kickoff today. Procurement is asking for a few urgent clarifications: they want UK data residency in the DPA, HSM-backed KMS for keys, and wire instructions before countersign. Also they may send a PO later today. cc @jordan-legal @sam-finance @mira-security

devon-se: On KMS — we support customer-managed keys in Redwood Private/Dedicated with KMS integration. Hosted API cannot meet an HSM-backed KMS requirement. If they insist on HSM, recommend Dedicated POC. @mira-security can confirm any extra controls.

mira-security: We need their security questionnaire and exact DPA redline requests. Short version: we can scope processing to the UK region for tenant data, add audit-log retention and SIEM hooks, but we need to see the proposed clause for review. I will prepare a minimal DPA addendum draft.

jordan-legal: Legal needs precise wording for the KMS/DPA changes. Also clarify who will sign: FrostoPay says their Procurement Lead will sign the order form, but Legal prefers DocuSign countersign with exec signoff for MSA changes. Sam — do you have their billing contact and PO format?

sam-finance: They want net30 and prefer EFT/wire. Need to validate bank details before we release invoice. Sample invoice fields I need confirmed:
```
Bill to: FrostoPay Ltd
PO #: <PO_NUMBER>
Amount: <AGREED_AMOUNT>
Payable to: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: FirstTrust Bank
Account: 12345678
Sort Code: 40-01-02
IBAN: GB12FTRU12345678901234
SWIFT: FTRUGB2L
```
Please confirm final amount and PO.

alice-sales: They pushed back on indemnity cap removal — procurement asked to remove cap for data breach-related claims. Jordan — is removing the cap a deal breaker?

jordan-legal: We can't remove the overall liability cap. We can offer a narrowly tailored carveout for proven gross negligence or willful misconduct related to data handling. Proposed wording: "Liability cap shall not apply to third-party claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct in handling Customer Data." Share with them and see if it's acceptable.

devon-se: Technical note for the DPA: we can provide request-level audit logs (request ID, timestamp, model variant, token counts), and we can disable prompt retention for the tenant. We cannot deliver raw prompt transcripts to external parties by default. We'll add a config flag for prompt retention = off for this POC.

mira-security: I'll assemble a security evidence pack (SOC 2 report excerpt, latest pen test summary, network diagrams) and draft answers to their questionnaire. Post it here and link the files. Ask them to attach their questionnaire PDF.

alice-sales: They just sent the questionnaire: https://frostopay.example/POC/security-q.pdf. POC timeline 3 weeks. Also mention they may require a signer-delegation affidavit if the procurement rep can't sign on behalf of the legal entity.

docuSign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelopeId=0a1b2c3. Signer order set to Procurement Lead -> Redwood Legal Countersign. Envelope link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3 :paperclip:

sam-finance: :thumbsup: I will confirm bank details and the invoice amount. @alice-sales — please attach the PO to the DocuSign envelope as an attachment once you receive it.

alice-sales: Will attach PO when it arrives. Any objections to proceeding with Dedicated + KMS for the POC so we can meet their HSM ask? :eyes:

jordan-legal: Legal is OK to proceed with Dedicated + KMS provided security signoff and the amended DPA is agreed. Proceeding contingent on the signed PO and finalized DPA addendum.

alice-sales: Great — looping in solutions to start provisioning Dedicated environment once PO is uploaded. I'll update thread with PO and the DocuSign link after sending. Thanks all!
